modelAnswer:
Dear Alex,

How are you? I’m writing to share some exciting news: I took a paper-cutting course this winter vacation and really enjoyed it.

A local artist taught us the basics of this traditional Chinese art. We learned to fold red paper, draw simple patterns and cut them out with scissors. Finally, I could cut out a “double happiness” character and a little snake, since 2025 is the Year of the Snake.

The course gave me more than a new skill. At first my cuts were messy, but I kept practising and became more patient. I also learned that each pattern carries a good wish, which helped me understand our festivals better.

I’ll send you one of my works soon!

Yours,
Li Hua

basics.form: 写给外国朋友的电子邮件，沿用题面给出的称呼 Dear Alex, 和落款 Yours, / Li Hua
basics.personTense: 第一人称；课程已经结束，讲经历用一般过去时，谈现在的体会和打算用一般现在时、一般将来时
basics.readerTone: 写给外国朋友，语气亲切、轻松，像聊天一样分享；对方不了解剪纸，要说得具体好懂
basics.goal: 让 Alex 知道我寒假学剪纸学了什么、有什么收获和感受，并愿意继续听我分享

taskRequires: 介绍剪纸课程学习的内容
说明自己的收获与感想
taskCard.thisEssayChooses: 开头直接点明寒假上了剪纸课；主体一段用“折纸、画样、剪纸”三个动作写学习内容，并以剪出的“囍”字和应 2025 蛇年的小蛇作成果；另一段写从剪坏到耐心的变化，以及懂得每个图案都寄托祝愿；结尾答应寄作品给朋友。

notes.role: 问候后马上点题：寒假上了剪纸课，而且很喜欢。

items.quote: I’m writing to share some exciting news
items.explain: 朋友之间开门见山说“有好消息分享”，Alex 一读就知道这封信要聊什么，比“I’m writing to tell you something”多了一点期待感。

items.quote: I took a paper-cutting course this winter vacation and really enjoyed it
items.explain: 一句话交代事件和态度，后文的“学了什么”“有什么收获”都从这里展开。

notes.role: 完成要点一：学习的内容，从基本功写到最后的成果。

items.quote: the basics of this traditional Chinese art
items.explain: 外国朋友不一定知道剪纸是什么，用 traditional Chinese art 顺手交代它的身份，不用另写一句介绍。

items.quote: fold red paper, draw simple patterns and cut them out with scissors
items.explain: 用三个动词按步骤写，把“学了剪纸”变成看得见的过程；三个动作并列，句子长而不乱。

items.quote: since 2025 is the Year of the Snake
items.explain: 用 since 说明为什么剪小蛇：2025 年是蛇年，成果和这个寒假过年联系起来，细节显得真实。

notes.role: 完成要点二：收获与感想，一个写自身变化，一个写对文化的认识。

items.quote: The course gave me more than a new skill.
items.explain: 段首句先说收获不止技能，读者知道下面要讲技能以外更深一层的收获，这句就是本段的提纲。

items.quote: At first my cuts were messy, but I kept practising
items.explain: 先写剪坏，再写坚持，用 but 写出变化，“变得更耐心”这个收获才有依据，不是空喊“我收获很多”。

items.quote: which helped me understand our festivals better
items.explain: which 接住前面“每个图案都有好的祝愿”这件事，说明它带来的认识，感想落到节日文化上。

notes.role: 收束：给朋友一个具体的下一步。

items.quote: I’ll send you one of my works soon
items.explain: 结尾答应寄作品，信写完朋友有东西可期待、可回应，比“希望你也来学”的套话更像朋友间的话。

expressions.expression: I’m writing to share some exciting news: …
expressions.function: 给朋友写信分享经历时的开头，冒号后直接说是什么事。

expressions.expression: … gave me more than a new skill.
expressions.function: 引出“收获不止于技能”，用来过渡到成长和感想。

expressions.expression: At first …, but I kept practising, and …
expressions.function: 用前后对比写出自己的变化，让收获有过程、有依据。

advanced.essay:
Dear Alex,

How have you been? Guess what? I spent part of my winter vacation on a paper-cutting course, and it turned out to be the highlight of my holiday.

Our teacher, a paper-cutting artist from my town, started with the basics: how to fold red paper, sketch a pattern and follow the lines with small, sharp scissors. My proudest work is a little snake surrounded by flowers. It now hangs on our window for the Spring Festival, as 2025 is the Year of the Snake.

The course gave me more than a new hobby. My first few pieces kept tearing, so I learned to slow down and stay patient. I also discovered that every pattern carries a wish, such as good luck or a long life, which made this old art feel close to me.

I’ve saved a paper snake for you. Can’t wait to hear what you think!

Yours,
Li Hua

beyondStandard.explain: 朋友间常用的口语开头，先卖个小关子再说事，比标准版的直接告知更像真实的聊天口吻。

beyondStandard.quote: follow the lines with small, sharp scissors
beyondStandard.explain: follow the lines 写出剪纸时沿着画好的线走剪刀的动作，比 cut them out 更具体，外国朋友更容易想象。

beyondStandard.quote: such as good luck or a long life, which made this old art feel close to me
beyondStandard.explain: 用 such as 举出图案寄托的具体祝愿，再写“老手艺离我很近”的感受，比标准版的“更懂节日”多了个人的情感。
